sourceFindings.description: Public routes omit /, preventing unauthenticated landing access.
Landing still introduces Otogami rather than Lyra.
Logout anchor has no href or handler; /logout route does exist.
renamePlaylist calls nonexistent PUT /api/playlists/:id/rename; existing API is PUT /api/playlists/:id.
sourceFindings.evidence: Source repaired; collection HTTP/SQLite regression suite passes. Production browser verification pending.

sourceFindings.description: Discovery detail joins artists through nonexistent tracks.artistId instead of artistsTracks.
sourceFindings.evidence: Source repaired; collection HTTP/SQLite regression suite passes. Production browser verification pending.

sourceFindings.description: Card playback passes nested discoveryPlaylistTrack objects directly to loadQueue; detail page correctly maps .track.
sourceFindings.evidence: Source repaired; collection HTTP/SQLite regression suite passes. Production browser verification pending.

sourceFindings.description: onMounted(refresh) redundantly restarts useLazyFetch and can cancel the initial request.
sourceFindings.evidence: Source repaired; collection HTTP/SQLite regression suite passes. Production browser verification pending.

sourceFindings.description: Owner check expects user.value.user.id; /api/auth/me returns the user object directly.
sourceFindings.evidence: Source repaired; collection HTTP/SQLite regression suite passes. Production browser verification pending.

sourceFindings.description: Duplicate detail route at [id]/index.get.ts returns a different bare station shape; clarify one response contract.
sourceFindings.evidence: Source repaired; collection HTTP/SQLite regression suite passes. Production browser verification pending.

sourceFindings.description: Forgot/reset password routes are listed as public but have no page files. No navigation to them is currently provided.
Repeated w-72/md:w-96 search inputs, h-[calc(100vh+5rem)] shells, large hero controls and nested overflow require real tablet/mobile checks.
Clickable div cards and track rows lack native navigation/keyboard semantics; options menus and icon-only controls need accessible names.
Image error toggles imageError but image src never consults it, so broken art does not actually fall back.

preserve: Two licensed albums and three audio fixture hashes
Existing listener credentials and migrated isolated SQLite database
Existing 115 Vitest and nine production E2E tests
extend: Seed ambient genre and both album relationships
Seed playlist and discovery collection with both local tracks
Seed dynamic local radio station with artist/genre seeds
Run a local external RSS fixture server with deterministic podcast episodes and licensed audio
Use a temporary media folder under the E2E fixture root for settings tests
testDataPlan.externalBoundary: RSS fixture server substitutes an external podcast publisher, not internal app logic. No provider API keys or production database writes.
testDataPlan.playwrightPlan: Original journeys retained on desktop/mobile, expanded to tablet and all26routes; focused core workflows and opt-in real Whistle and EmbeddingGemma production tests.
testDataPlan.status: Implemented isolated genre, playlist, discovery, radio and local external RSS publisher seeds.

implementationGroups.owner: fixtures_and_e2e (core pages), whistle_implementation (track/options menu), root (global search)

compact320.scope: All authenticated routes and representative public/player/dialog views

text200.scope: 32px body text via equivalent user stylesheet; public/library/player/dialog controls

productionRuns.scope: Complete production suite: 49 runtime-free cases, three actual EmbeddingGemma browser journeys and one actual Whistle HTTP-to-SQLite case.
Evidence-only doubled-text rerun after adding exact station detail URL and level-1 heading readiness. Same production bundle; no application change.

negativeEvidence.cause: Repeated contrast failures and redundant radio-choice request cancellations, plus an overstrict test login-query expectation.
A delayed playlist autofocus stole focus back from Cancel after real Tab navigation.

redesignVerification.text200Scope: One desktop 1440x1000 journey with 200% text/rem sizing and compact navigation/player. Seven supplemental viewport views prove controls are reachable; the two stitched full-page radio images provide context only.
redesignVerification.semanticQuality: The separate Evalite quality gate remains failing at 27/28; browser and deterministic tests do not establish model quality.

secondProductionRun.notes: Negative-control evidence for RSS XML parsing, mobile options-menu close, accessible-name mismatches; remaining failures include outdated harness assumptions corrected before next run.

productionRuns.scope: Full suite with both real local models: 26 routes across three viewports, 20 authenticated routes at 320px plus public/player/dialog views, doubled text and all focused journeys.
Three route sweeps, three core album/menu journeys and three real search/playback journeys after track-row wrapping and search-inset fixes; includes direct 320px spacing assertions.

historicalEditorialVerification.semanticQuality: The separate Evalite quality gate remains failing at 27/28; browser and deterministic tests do not establish model quality.

historicalListeningVerification.changedBehavior: Actual Mediabunny MP3 decoding, independently measured waveform amplitudes, malformed-byte recovery, native request cancellation and playback preservation, current-station queue preservation, podcast ineligibility and combined 320px/200% text reflow.
historicalListeningVerification.unitEvidence: 230 passed, six opt-in model cases skipped; separate actual-codec proof and historical model runtime results are not added to this count.
historicalListeningVerification.historicalEvidence: redesignVerification and historicalEditorialVerification below describe earlier revisions. Build 3 of the current listening change was interrupted after 52 completed browser cases; only build 5 establishes the complete 61-case result.
historicalListeningVerification.remainingGaps: Other browser engines, native mobile browsers and complete site-wide doubled-text coverage are unverified. The separate semantic-quality gate remains failing at 27/28.

currentControlsVerification.changedBehavior: Automatic complete waveforms beneath native range seeking; real pointer/keyboard/outside-release behavior; shared volume disclosure/mute; decode fallback/reselection/track cancellation; focused password eye controls; no external podcast music-history submission.
currentControlsVerification.unitEvidence: 279 passed, six opt-in model cases skipped; separate real PCM/native-Chromium codec proof is not counted as model inference.
currentControlsVerification.remainingGaps: Other browser engines, native mobile browsers and every route at doubled text remain unverified. Semantic quality gate remains historically failing27/28.

sourceFindingsNote: Source findings and their original status wording preserve the initial audit; current route/control verification is recorded separately above.
